post.description: B.4: the CSM bilinear model for a material.
B.5: cross-section slenderness and the strain limit eps_csm / eps_y (B.6, B.7).
B.6.2: CSM compression resistance (B.5 for the section, then B.15 to B.17).

B.6.3.1(1) and B.6.3.2: CSM bending resistance about an axis of symmetry (B.5 for the
section in bending, then B.19 or B.20 with the α of Table B.2).

A, centroid, I, W_el, W_pl, plastic axes and shear centre from the template dimensions.

Reference values (geometry, not a rule of EN 1993-1-4): they enter no calculation unless the
user copies one into an input field.
B.5 for the same section made thicker and thinner, to compare stocky with slender.

BendingAxisKey.title: BendingAxisKey
BendingAxisKey.description: The axis of bending (Table B.2): y-y is the major axis, z-z the minor axis.

BendingFormulaKey.title: BendingFormulaKey
BendingFormulaKey.description: Which formula of B.6.3.2 gave the resistance (stable machine key).

selected.title: Selected
selected.description: The row that gave alpha for this section and axis

BendingParameterRowOut.title: BendingParameterRowOut
BendingParameterRowOut.description: One printed row of Table B.2.

axis.description: Axis of bending; may be left out for a circular hollow section only

poisson_ratio.title: Poisson Ratio
poisson_ratio.description: Poisson ratio nu, an input; not needed with sigma_cr

w_el.title: W El
w_el.description: Elastic section modulus W_el about the axis [mm3], an input

w_pl.title: W Pl
w_pl.description: Plastic section modulus W_pl about the axis [mm3], an input

BendingRequest.title: BendingRequest
BendingRequest.description:
The section in bending (B.6.3.1(1), B.6.3.2): every value outside Annex B is an input.

In `geometry`, `k_sigma`, `plates[].k_sigma` and `sigma_cr_cs` are the values for the
*bending* stress pattern about the chosen axis, not those of compression (EN 1993-1-5, 6.4.1).

strain_ratio.title: Strain Ratio
strain_ratio.description: eps_csm / eps_y, from B.5.1, section in bending

table_b2.title: Table B2
table_b2.description: Table B.2, the used row marked

elastic_moment.title: Elastic Moment
elastic_moment.description: W_el f_y / gamma_M0 [N mm], a reference line

plastic_moment.title: Plastic Moment
plastic_moment.description: W_pl f_y / gamma_M0 [N mm], a reference line

blocks_figure.title: Blocks Figure

factor.title: Factor

stress.title: Stress

governing_label.title: Governing Label
governing_label.description: The plate that sets the slenderness at this point

ComparisonRequest.title: ComparisonRequest
ComparisonRequest.description: Same inputs as B.5. The section must be plates or a circular hollow section.

CompressionFormulaKey.title: CompressionFormulaKey
CompressionFormulaKey.description: Which formula of B.6.2 gave the resistance (stable machine key).

poisson_ratio.title: Poisson Ratio

capacity_figure.title: Capacity Figure

point_figure.title: Point Figure

poisson_ratio.description: Poisson ratio nu, an input; not needed with sigma_cr

sides.title: Sides

GeometryInput.title: GeometryInput
GeometryInput.description:
The section. Which fields are needed depends on `kind` (the API says what is missing).

With kind "template" give `shape` and its dimensions in mm; the engine derives the flat width c
of each plate as 8.2.2(5) and Tables 7.2 to 7.4 draw it. k_sigma of each plate is an input.

GoverningKey.title: GoverningKey
GoverningKey.description: Which term of Formula B.14 governs the tensile strain limit (stable machine key).
